comments.note: spdb-indexer/SPDB Indexer/sql/structure.sql was generated in February 2021 (MariaDB 10.4.10) and predates several schema migrations (Rev 33 added year/season/episode, Rev 34 extended movies_bookmarks). Adding a `-- db_revision: N` header comment would prevent future drift and make it clear which migrations are captured.
